results.eligibility_evidence: Original NucleoNet neural Slater-Jastrow VMC result. Nuclear positions are held fixed during electronic sampling (Section 2); an energy expectation of the neural wavefunction, without extrapolation or projection. Tables specify Hartree and parenthesized statistical uncertainty in the last reported digit.
results.notes: Proposal only: exact molecular geometry, Hamiltonian convention and spin sector must be resolved before benchmark registration. Statistical uncertainty type is not specified as standard error or standard deviation; energy variance is not tabulated.
